changes.reason: G8: bind and prove the tagged unit UV-passkey required-password-change carryover guarantee, scoped to its actual selected tests; preserve TOTP state and originating-client protection.
G8: bind the real HTTP/PostgreSQL carryover, foreign handle-only refusal, originating-client completion, replay refusal and password MFA control under the integration profile.

G8: qualify cookie refusal as authentication-cookie refusal while permitting the dedicated originating-client binding cookie; retain required-change, expiry, provider-link and method-audit guarantees.

G8 BN2: bind the PostgreSQL pending-login client-binding constraint of unreleased migration 0057, tightened in place: exactly 32 bytes on password_change_passkey_uv and NULL on enroll, verify and password_change, proved RED at e9ecdff and GREEN at the fix.

G5: bind ordered account prelocking and the shared-create/exclusive-delete lifecycle lock; cover the between-account and new-account windows, both roles, SQLSTATE 40P01 mutations and common deletion timestamp without claiming unrelated lifecycle inversions are fixed.
G4: bind the real PostgreSQL administrative case/spaces and legacy mixed-case lookup regression, preserving singleton administrative visibility, return fields and missing-account sentinel.

G7: bind the cross-instance single-winner setup collision test and its 410 setup_already_complete refusal, with guard-removal mutation evidence; minimum two pool connections and bounded rollback cleanup stay stated limits.

G7: bind the no-overwrite proof: a completion arriving while the winner is still writing answers 410 and leaves the winner's organization, contact, password and single audit pair, with guard-removal mutation evidence (M1).

G7: bind the failed-winner retry proof: failure of the winner's first active-signing-key read after its organization and administrator writes leaves setup required, and the identical request on another instance then succeeds without duplicates, with leaked-guard mutation evidence (M2). Split from SETUP-COMPLETE-ONCE-2 because one RULE tag binds one test function.
G7: keep atomic first-key provisioning and default-key reuse while replacing the obsolete two-success completion wording with the single-winner setup contract.
G7: the bound test now drives two concurrent key-provisioning attempts on PostgreSQL under one completion winner and is renamed accordingly; the in-memory completion lock now serializes.

G7: the red proof is re-recorded for the renamed key-provisioning test (mutation A signingKeyEnsureLock -> SELECT 1, mutation B unconditional Generate, each FAIL 5/5), superseding the v0.9.14 two-completion proof.
G6, deferred by owner to v0.9.15: rehash the existing rotation binding after test-owned key cleanup and corrected pool-cleanup ordering; rotation and rollback assertions are unchanged.
